lines.text: Did Nero really fiddle while Rome burned?
Flames everywhere, and he plays a tune!
When the fire began, says Tacitus, Nero was not even in Rome.
He came back and opened his own gardens to the homeless.
The fire raged for six days.
And a rumour spread: while Rome burned, Nero sang of the fall of Troy.
Sang, perhaps. Fiddled, never. The fiddle came about a thousand years later.
His instrument was the cithara, a kind of lyre with seven strings.
